intentsFees.Fees: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators.
intentsFees.Revenue: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded.
intentsFees.ProtocolRevenue: Captured revenue held by the treasury before the 2026-02-23 buyback program.
intentsFees.HoldersRevenue: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.
intentsFees.SupplySideRevenue: Gross fees minus NEAR's captured revenue - the affiliate fees kept by solvers and third-party distribution channels (e.g. SwapKit).

intentsHoldersRevenue.Fees: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators.
intentsHoldersRevenue.Revenue: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded.
intentsHoldersRevenue.ProtocolRevenue: Captured revenue held by the treasury before the 2026-02-23 buyback program.
intentsHoldersRevenue.HoldersRevenue: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.
intentsHoldersRevenue.SupplySideRevenue: Gross fees minus NEAR's captured revenue - the affiliate fees kept by solvers and third-party distribution channels (e.g. SwapKit).

chainGasFees.Fees: All transaction (gas) fees paid by users on the NEAR blockchain, fetched from Allium.
chainGasFees.Revenue: Gas fees permanently burned, reducing NEAR supply. Before 4 November 2026 (protocol upgrade v87) the burn is estimated at 70% of fees, the rest went to contract developers; since then 100% of gas fees are burned.
chainGasFees.HoldersRevenue: Burned gas fees accrue to all NEAR holders through reduced supply: an estimated 70% of fees before 4 November 2026 (protocol upgrade v87), 100% since then.
chainGasFees.SupplySideRevenue: Gas rewards rebated to the developer of the called contract, estimated at 30% of fees before 4 November 2026. Protocol upgrade v87 removed developer gas rewards, so this is 0 since then.
